title: Classic Deviled Eggs with Paprika and Chives
summary: Eggs are steamed until fully set, iced and peeled; the yolks are mashed with mayonnaise, mustard powder and cider vinegar and piped back into the whites.
equipment: medium saucepan with a lid and steamer basket
piping bag with a large star nozzle (or a sandwich bag)

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Steam the eggs
steps.text: Bring 2-3 cm water to a rolling boil. Put the eggs in a steamer basket over the water, cover and cook over medium heat for 13 minutes until both whites and yolks are completely firm.

steps.title: Chill
steps.text: Lift the eggs into iced water and leave 15 minutes.

steps.title: Halve
steps.text: Peel, halve lengthwise and tip the yolks into a bowl. Set the 12 best white halves on a plate.

steps.title: Make the filling
steps.text: Mash the yolks finely, then mix in the mayonnaise, mustard powder, vinegar, salt, pepper and cayenne until smooth.

steps.title: Pipe
steps.text: Spoon into a piping bag and pipe a generous swirl into each white.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Dust with paprika and scatter with chives.

tips: Steaming makes eggs easier to peel than boiling.
Cooking one extra egg covers any whites that tear.
Pipe just before serving; keep filling and whites chilled separately until then.
storage: Keep covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Do not leave out for more than 2 hours. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
